figurative_meaning_bn: কাজ এড়িয়ে চলা বা অলস ব্যক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: a person who shirks work or is lazy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কামচোর, কখনো কাজ করে না।
অফিসে কামচোর লোকের জন্য সবাই কষ্ট পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a slacker and never does any work.
Everyone suffers because of lazybones in the office.
note: The original meaning provided ('আসঙ্গলিপ্সা') appears to be a possible transcription error; interpreted as relating to laziness based on standard usage of the idiom.
